title: Bridging Semantics and Strategy: A Dual-Stream Graph Network for Equitable Negotiation Forecasting

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates distributive equity in negotiation forecasting by measuring 'Inequality Discrepancy' (ID), which quantifies the model's ability to accurately reflect utility gaps between negotiating parties. It specifically addresses historical biases that favor corporate or institutional stakeholders over individuals by implementing a fairness-regularized loss function that penalizes deviations from ground-truth distributive outcomes.
